sources.administrativeHierarchy: bd_geo_code database (phpMyAdmin export): divisions, districts, upazilas, unions with English/Bangla names and government website urls
sources.postalCodes: Bangladesh Post Office (bdpost.gov.bd) official lists, as compiled in the Bengali Wikipedia post-code tables; supplemented by area-level codes from the local post office station list
sources.coordinates: Generated/curated coordinates for districts, upazilas and areas
sources.aliases: Wikidata alternate names (skos:altLabel) + curated spelling variants; every record also carries its Bangla name as a search alias
sources.boundaries: geoBoundaries (gbOpen BGD ADM1/ADM2/ADM3 simplified), joined by name; 19 post-2015 upazilas have no polygons yet
sources.delivery: City corporation list (Local Government Division); Dhaka metro = Dhaka district upazilas; sadar derived from names
sources.bbsCodes: Official BBS geo codes (DGHS BBScode, app.dghs.gov.bd): divisions 8/8, districts 64/64, upazilas 466/502, areas 3648/4540; missing codes are newer upazilas/areas absent from the BBS register
sources.verification: 2026-08-09 verification pass: upazila postal codes cross-checked against official bdpost lists (8 fixed: Jibannagar 7230, Daulatpur-Kushtia 7050, Khoksa 7021, Koyra 9290, Kaliganj-Jhenaidah 7350, Sreepur-Gazipur 1740, Bandar 1410, Narayanganj Sadar 1400); coordinates verified against Wikidata P625 (92 upazilas corrected/filled)
sources.cityThanas: 67 city thanas added (2026-08-09) for Dhaka (41), Chattogram (11), Khulna (4), Rajshahi (4), Sylhet (1), Barisal (1), Rangpur (1), Narayanganj (3), Gazipur (1); postal codes from bdpost lists/postcodebd/deshamar, coordinates from geoBoundaries ADM3, BBS codes from DGHS register
sources.thanaModel: Thanas are linked to their parent upazila via parentUpazilaId where applicable (Tongi→Gazipur Sadar, Fatullah/Siddhirganj/Baidder Bazar→Narayanganj Sadar, Ashulia→Savar, Zindabazar→Sylhet Sadar); city-corporation thanas (Gulshan, Mirpur, Kotwali...) have no upazila parent

codeScheme.upazila: fullCode = <district code>-<internal upazila id>, e.g. BD-A-06-137; stable internal id, official BBS codes not yet assigned
codeScheme.area: fullCode = <upazila fullCode>-<internal area id>, e.g. BD-A-06-137-1185; stable internal id

knownLimitations.upazilaAreaCodes: Official BBS geo codes are not yet assigned to upazilas/areas; the internal numeric ids are stable and unique
knownLimitations.newUpazilas: 8 newly created upazilas added with no union data yet (approved 2021-2026): Indurkani (Pirojpur), Bangra (Comilla), Chandraganj (Lakshmipur), Matamuhuri (Coxs Bazar), Mokamtola (Bogura), South Gafargaon (Mymensingh), Ruhia and Bhully (Thakurgaon); Bangra carries postal code 4543
knownLimitations.duplicateUnionNames: 4 union names repeat within their upazila in the source data (Natai, Awajpur, Talimpur, Bhojoanpur)
knownLimitations.bbsCoverage: BBS codes absent for 36 upazilas (post-2015 creations) and 892 areas; codes follow the official 2+2+3+2 digit concatenation
knownLimitations.coords: Upazila coordinates sourced from Wikidata (official items); ~30 upazilas retain generated coordinates where Wikidata items were ambiguous
knownLimitations.cityThanas: City thanas have no union data (wards not yet mapped); a few postal codes are provider-sourced; Bangshal/Chak Bazar/Kamrangir Char use the old-Dhaka cluster codes
knownLimitations.newThanas: 6 newer thanas added without postal codes (not yet in bdpost lists): Jorargonj (Mirsharai), Akbar Shah, EPZ (Chattogram city), Daulatpur (Khulna city, BBS code 4047021), Jalalabad (Sylhet city), Shahjahanpur (Dhaka city); coordinates approximate where sourced from parent upazila
